item.title: Marquette County Sheriff’s Dept. receives new body camera system
item.description: The Marquette County Sheriff's Department has gone through with the purchase of a new Motorola body camera system. All 31 new units will be used by road patrol officers, with plans for the department's existing cameras to pass along to county jail staff.

item.title: Applications open for 2026-27 Construction Connect U.P. program
item.description: Current high school juniors around the Marquette, Iron Mountain, or Escanaba areas interested in trades work can sign up for this job-site experience. This will allow them to work with HVAC, electric, and general contractors throughout their senior year.

item.title: Clintons Scheduled for Closed-Door Deposition Over Epstein, Encourage GOP to Allow Public Hearing
item.description: Up until this week, the Clintons had resisted testifying — despite congressional subpoenas — but once the House made plans to move forward with holding them in contempt of Congress, a deal was struck and they will now appear later this month before lawmakers.
